text:
Priya Patel: quick sketch — trying to simplify the structured-output lane so tool results don't dominate the run list, attaching screenshot https://imgur.com/fake123 :eyes:
Jordan Lee: looks good, maybe collapse tool output to a single line summary with a chevron to expand? keeps focus on user text.
Priya Patel: yea that was my idea, but worried about discoverability for function outputs (users expect to see JSON schema).
Alex Rivera: what if we show a single-line summary + small schema badge that opens a mini inspector on hover/click? aria role=button, tabindex=0
Samir Khan: Accessibility note — hover-only is bad for keyboard users. prefer click to open and visible focus ring. also add descriptive aria-label like "Open output schema inspector"
Jordan Lee: agree. also copy tweak: "View output" vs "Schema" — which is clearer to PMs?
Priya Patel: "View output" is more user-friendly, "Schema" for advanced users. maybe show "View output (Schema)"? long though.
Alex Rivera: short proposal: label = "Output preview" and a subtle "Schema" pill in the inspector header. keeps toolbar compact.
UI-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/4242 (testable on keyboard nav)
Samir Khan: tested quickly — tab order seems off: focus goes to run timestamp before output preview, should be reversed so preview is next.
Priya Patel: noted. can we also reduce visual weight of tool-calling badge? current blue is too noisy in compact nav.
Jordan Lee: try #6B7280 (muted gray) for badge bg and 600 for text, keeps contrast but lower emphasis.
Alex Rivera: will push a small CSS change and adjust focus styles. I'll also add a11y text: "Tool output. Press enter to open inspector."
Samir Khan: +1 on explicit keyboard hint. also propose an aria-live region for run errors so screen readers get immediate feedback after a tool call.
Priya Patel: solid. last UX thing — run history rows: when collapsed, show micro-timestamp, first 2 tokens of assistant reply, and a collapsed badge count for tool calls (e.g., "2 tools"). expand shows full callstack.
Jordan Lee: that helps scannability in long histories. can we animate expand/collapse for context? small height transition only.
Alex Rivera: sure, will add 120ms ease transition. updating the PR now.
UI-bot: PR 7892 created by Alex Rivera: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/7892 :rocket:
Priya Patel: thanks — will review for copy and accessibility tomorrow. if everyone else OK, mark for design review this Friday. :calendar:
Samir Khan: fine with me. :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: looks good from product side.
Priya Patel: great, leaving follow-ups in the PR review checklist.
